feature_contract.goal: Restore authentic 4:3 Quest front-end menu by using the game's actual default UI scaling and letterbox modes across missing Graphics keys and layered base/user INI configuration, while preserving exact optical placement and fallback.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only x64 OpenXR host front-end theater letterbox configuration selection and its existing deterministic menu verifier; never modify gameplay HUD, F11, ESC, world stereo, DX11, DXVK, SkyGlow or FFB.
trace_stages: Original game UIScaling settings default to 1 and draw 4:3 letterbox bars even when INI Graphics keys are absent.
x64 VR host reads the game installation's base/user INI and chooses centered 4:3 crop before GetGameUv projection.
Common-FOV LOCAL theater menu sends the resulting 4:3 UV and centered rectangle to both OpenXR eyes; stale/absent config stays fail-closed.
subcomponents: Match compiled game defaults on missing Graphics values without suppressing existing explicit vanilla/unletterboxed modes.
Read a valid user INI even when the main INI is absent, retaining user precedence, absent-both fail-closed and bounded 2.5-second HWND polling.
Extend exact-SHA menu regression verifier with seeded layering cases and destructive mutations, preserving 4:3/16:9/21:9/portrait geometry.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: First launch/INI with absent Graphics keys uses the same (1,1) defaults as the game, allowing the already implemented 4:3 menu crop and identical left/right projection.
Explicit mode zero disables crop; user file wins even without base INI; neither file still fails closed; monitor/Reset clipping and optical fallback remain intact.
Seeded positive/negative menu and INI parsing tests plus final exact-SHA DX9Ex Active Win32 host/game/package, Domain Isolation and Full Source Impact gates pass.

diagnosis.original_evidence: The game's Settings::UIScalingMode and Settings::UILetterboxing default to 1, but the host used GetPrivateProfileIntW default 0 for both and discarded an absent main INI before considering .user.ini.
diagnosis.root_cause: The game and x64 host independently resolved missing Graphics keys with conflicting defaults, so captured already-letterboxed menus could be incorrectly classified as raw desktop and not centered-cropped.
source_trace: Game UI defaults and 4:3 menu sprite/letterbox path
R23GameMenuIsLetterboxed game-image path and base/user configuration layers
PlanVisibleCenteredContent common XR FOV crop fed to RenderMenuPlaneTo for the two eyes
alternatives_rejected: Changing the OpenXR common tangent FOV cannot infer missing game settings.
Applying a general vertical/Y HUD offset would move protected gameplay and world-attached ranks.
Disabling the original game's letterbox would sacrifice authored 4:3 geometry and unrelated desktop behavior.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: This gate only authorizes a shared LOCAL menu UV crop; left/right OpenXR views keep the same projected menu aspect and existing recenter behavior.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Twelve seeded first-run/base/user precedence cases and six destructive source mutations; HMD remains untested.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Host fallbacks now agree with source-game (1,1), continue loading user INI if base missing, and fail closed with neither file.
